bio: This buzzing bistro on Granby's main thoroughfare is run by François Côté, previously encountered at the restaurant Joe Beef. The indulgent and sincere menu revolves around hearty down-to-earth fare (calf's liver with soubise sauce, macaroni au gratin with lobster, pudding chômeur) and a smattering of Asian influences (izakaya-style mackerel, kamikaze-style salmon tartare, halibut from the Gaspé Peninsula etc). The decor of wood and leather in the long, narrow space exudes warmth; laid-back service.
